from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
raw=Path('reports/candidates/TICKET-028/package')
null=json.loads((raw/'null-compare.json').read_text())
assert null['data']['visibilityMetrics']==[
 {'metric':'attempted','unit':'count','before':2,'after':1,'difference':-1},
 {'metric':'successful','unit':'count','before':2,'after':0,'difference':-2},
 {'metric':'failed','unit':'count','before':0,'after':1,'difference':1},
 {'metric':'coverage','unit':'fraction','before':1,'after':0,'difference':-1},
 {'metric':'mentionRate','unit':'fraction','before':0,'after':None,'difference':None},
 {'metric':'citationRate','unit':'fraction','before':0,'after':None,'difference':None}]
default=json.loads((raw/'default-compare.json').read_text())
assert default['summary']=={'pass':1,'fail':0,'unknown':3}
assert default['data']['counts']=={'added':0,'removed':0,'status-changed':0,'details-changed':0,'unchanged':3}
assert [x['id'] for x in default['findings']]==['finding:collection-coverage','finding:provenance','finding:recommendations','comparison-scope']
assert 'visibilityMetrics' not in default['data']
assert not any(x['id'].startswith('visibility-metric:') for x in default['findings'])
for side in ['before','after']:
 p=raw/(side+'-visibility.json')
 assert default['data'][side]['report']==json.loads(p.read_text())
 assert default['data'][side]['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print('All six literal null/count/coverage rows and complete default summary/categories/source finding IDs/documents/digests verified against original installed-consumer outputs. No product rerun.')
description: Additional literal artifact assertions against original installed-consumer outputs; no product/package rerun.
